bio.text: John Kulewicz, an attorney from Upper Arlington, won the Democratic primary for Ohio Attorney General in May 2026 and is the party's nominee in the November general election, according to unofficial results projected by the Associated Press.

A Columbus native, he returned to the city after law school and a clerkship for a federal judge, entered private practice, and was twice elected to the Upper Arlington City Council. He says he has practiced law for more than four decades.

sources.title: Columbus lawyer John Kulewicz wins Ohio Democratic primary for Attorney General
Ohio attorney general candidates push for non-partisan leader in office
